mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and business investment, which depresses corporate earnings growth. The negative correlation between UNRATE and equity returns is consistent across historical data.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 8% (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is high (UNRATE > 8%) and housing starts are low (HOUST < 600), the economy is in a recessionary state that depresses corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE>8% AND HOUST<600), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), the Federal Reserve's policy shift increases discount rates and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 92 and unemployment (UNRATE) remains above 8%, the economy is in a supply-constrained recession, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO<92 AND UNRATE>8%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below 350000, it signals a weakening residential sector and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 350000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tight monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
